integrity.mathematical_evidence: Explicit all-parameter proof and independent finite modular-matrix comparisons
integrity.verification_scope: Prime fields 3, 5, 7, n<=8 and exhaustive rank census of 4-by-4 alternating forms over F3 and F5

scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic only; degree-two exterior multipliers only; no higher-form operators or arbitrary induced exterior-power actions. Classical inclusion-matrix diagonal forms and alternating-form counts are antecedents, not original contributions. A possible equivalent result in older modular symplectic literature remains a priority risk.
title: Modular graded Jordan spectra of bivector multiplication in exterior algebras
